newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: German City Estates buys Dutch UBF.
newsitem.headline: German City Estates buys Dutch UBF.

text.p: German City Estates NV (GCE) said on Monday it had agreed to acquire the Dutch investment company UBF Vastgoed BV from Merita Real Estate of Finland for 67 million guilders.
UBF, the largest single acquisition by GCE, has investments of eight recently constructed and fully let office buildings totalling 26,000 square metres

The properties are located in The Hague, Amsterdam and Eindhoven and produce a current income of some 6,7 million guilders from tenants which include the Dutch Government, Dell Computers, Face and Bull, GCE said.
GCE, which arranged the acquisition with 58 million guilder project finance, had recently bought property in Luxembourg for 12.5 million guilders.
"It is in line with the Company's strategy of seeking investments with better than average return and growth potential not readily available in the German market," it said.
Finland's Merita said earlier on Monday it had sold real estate in The Hague and Veldhoven worth 180 million markka.
